prompt_template.description: Biomedical abstract synonym extraction (aligned with synonym_extraction)
prompt_template.system: You are a biomedical synonym specialist.
prompt_template.human:
Task:
1. Identify every noun term/phrase in the abstract that has at least one exact biomedical synonym (abbreviations, CAS numbers, alternative names, plural forms all allowed).
2. Use the NER entity list below as hints; only include pairs where both strings appear in the abstract.
3. For each such term/phrase, generate one standalone declarative sentence of the form:
original|is|synonym1
original|is|synonym2
...
4. Output only those sentences, one per line, no header, no abstract.
- Do not add any introductory sentences like "Here is the output..."
- Ensure that all terms and synonyms are exactly as they appear in the abstract. No variations or additional text.

NER entities (JSON, hints only):
{entities}

Abstract:
{text}
